purpose: Prospective stochastic replication of the sole strict guided success; selected-case reliability, not new-protein generalization.
controls: Reproduce all four historical samples in both arms; fresh batch16 versus four batches4 latent parity; CFG2 exact FP64 rigid-pose parity.
refolding: Refold every strict raw match in both arms, eight fixed-motif ProteinMPNN sequences each, and the native scaffold with the same motif sequence fixed. Repeat its first refold. Include every raw failure in the denominator of16 per arm.
strict: Raw and same refold coarse valid, motif dRMS<=1A and proper CA RMSD<=1A; that same refold global scTM>0.5. Native fixed-motif strict control must pass.
diversity: For each successful generated backbone take its first qualifying refold index; report all pairwise global TM and proper motif-aligned scaffold RMSD among these refolds, separately by arm. Undefined with fewer than two successes.
scope: One previously selected development family. No noise/strength sweeps, no development labels for training, no locked-test access.
